name: [Portal] Go-live CZ/SK/HU: rollout, module activation and registration opening
description:
### Summary

This task takes the Partner Portal MVP from a finished set of features to a service that existing and new partners in the Czech, Slovak and Hungarian markets actually use. It covers the staged rollout, starting with the internal alpha planned for the fourth quarter of 2026, continuing with a group of pilot partners and ending with all partners, the bulk activation of the portal module for the projects of existing partners, and the moment self-registration is opened to the public. It also delivers the go-live checklist: monitoring and error alerting, a handover to support including a known-issues page, and a tested rollback plan. Before the final stage it verifies that migrated partner profile cards and the connected partner websites are live, and it coordinates the schedule and messaging with the Partnership team. The content of the marketing campaign, the choice of target groups and the definition of success metrics stay outside this task and are decided elsewhere.

### Why?

The MVP has a working production target of April 2027, with a slip of about one month accepted, and it must reach existing partners and new registrations in three markets at once. Individually finished features do not make a launch; without a controlled rollout, activated modules, monitoring and a prepared support team, the first weeks would generate exactly the manual work the portal is meant to remove. A staged approach limits the blast radius of defects found by real partners and gives Partnership a predictable schedule to communicate.

### What?

The portal is available in production for every existing partner project in CZ, SK and HU, and new partners can register on their own. The rollout passed through the internal alpha and a pilot group before the general opening, each stage closed by an explicit go/no-go decision. Operations have monitoring and error alerting, support has a handover document and a known-issues page, and a rollback plan exists and has been rehearsed. Migrated medailonky and the partner websites are confirmed live before the public opening. Partnership has the launch schedule and agreed messaging for partners.

### Acceptance Criteria

A written rollout plan exists with three stages (internal alpha Q4 2026, pilot partners, all partners), each with entry/exit criteria and a named go/no-go owner; every stage transition is recorded with date and decision.

At the general-opening stage the partnerPortal module is active on 100% of projects of existing partners in CZ, SK and HU; activation runs through a repeatable, idempotent procedure (not per-project clicking) and the result is reconciled against CRM partner records.

Self-registration with e-mail verification is open for CZ, SK and HU at the general-opening stage; a new partner completes registration to first login in production without manual intervention.

Monitoring and error alerting for the portal entry points are live before the pilot stage; an induced error on staging triggers an alert in the agreed channel.

Support has received a handover session, a handover document and a known-issues page before the pilot stage; the page is updated after each stage.

A rollback plan (module deactivation, closing registration, websites staying on migrated data) is documented and rehearsed on staging before general opening; the measured rollback time is recorded.

Before general opening a checklist confirms that migrated medailonky are published on all three partner websites and that the websites read from the API; Partnership signs the confirmation off.

Any new PHP (e.g. the bulk activation command) has unit tests and passes PHPStan level 10; any React changes pass make fe-test; a production smoke test of login, registration, medailonek edit and public display is run and recorded at each stage.

### Open questions

- Wiki Q6: go-to-market and the opening schedule are a product decision after the real scope is verified; this task assumes the working target of April 2027 with an acceptable slip of one month.
- Pilot partner selection: who picks the pilot group, how large it is, and whether it must cover all three markets.
- Whether HU launches simultaneously with CZ and SK or follows, given the state of the Hungarian partner website and remaining localisation (Wiki Q7).

### Technical notes

_Generated by Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-09-16_

- Module gating: `Shoptet\Crm\Model\Modules::isActive()` in `cms/packages/Crm/Model/Modules.php` (per-project cache — call `invalidateProjectCache()` after bulk activation); controllers are gated by `#[RequiresActiveModule('partnerPortal')]` from `cms/packages/Contracts/Framework/Http/RequiresActiveModule.php`.
- Manual activation today: CRM `crm/admin/controllers/ModuleActivateController.php` (`adminActivateModuleAction`) over `cms/packages/Crm/Helper/ModulesHelper.php`; bulk activation should be a Symfony console command (archetype `st-archetype-console`) selecting projects from `st_crm.partner` and reusing the same helper, idempotent and dry-run capable.
- Module and nav definitions: `cms2_modules` / `modules` in `database/schema/st_crm.sql`; the partnerPortal admin page is registered by `migrations/2026/devrel/cms/CZ3TDR1-542/add_partner_portal_page_drop.sql` in `cms2_admin_section_map`.
- Portal entry points to monitor: `admin/controllers/PartnerPortal/`, `admin/react/src/PartnerPortal/`, `config/app/partner-portal-services.neon`; CODEOWNERS routes them to `@shoptet/devrel-team`.
